PIB - Auction Result (Nov 04, 2026)
SBP raised PkR393bn against a target of PkR350bn. Yields declined by 11 and 10bps for the 3, and 5-year tenor compared to the previous auction, while 2 and 10-yr paper yields remained unchanged.
#Auction #Tbill #PIB
